text: A SAFETYNET briefing room. Netherton drops a financial dossier on the table. Nightshade already has the transaction graph open.
Agent 0x00. Every cell we have hit is being paid by someone. Tonight we chase the money. HaX.
Money's just another protocol, and this one leaks. Follow enough hops and the mixers stop hiding people and start revealing them.
Two payments we've traced so far. One came in, one went out, and both went through the same exchange.
In: Ransomware Incorporated's wallet. $2.4 million in one payment this summer, hospital ransoms pooled.
Out: $847,000 to the Insider Threat Initiative for the Quantum Dynamics job, through TalentStack's wallet.
Somebody is keeping the books for all of them.
HashChain Exchange. A trading platform on paper. In practice, the bank for every ENTROPY cell we know. The Crypto Anarchists run it.
Their mixer takes Bitcoin in, runs it through Monero, and pays it into one of their own cold wallets.
From outside, the trail stops there. Their own records pick it up again.
Two people matter. The CEO calls himself "Satoshi Nakamoto the Second". True believer. Nobody turns him.
The CTO, Dr Irina Volkova, built the mixer. She might turn.
Thirty-seven papers in cryptography. She built their privacy systems for "financial freedom". Now they wash ransoms.
Our profile says that sits badly with her.
Show her what her work is paying for. If she turns, she opens the mixer up for us.
If she won't, you detain her and hand her to the police with the evidence.
You go in as the FCA, the Financial Conduct Authority, on a routine supervisory visit.
Regulators ask to see everything, so nobody minds when you do.
The paperwork gets you past reception. It won't survive a phone call to the FCA, so don't give anyone a reason to make one.
Your usual kit: picks, the RFID cloner and the print kit. No PIN cracker this time; R&D still have it on the bench.
Their backend first. Crack the accounts from the terminal in their server room and bring the flags to our drop-site.
Then their records. Somewhere in there is a wallet every cell draws on.
And there's a clock. The wallets we watch have gone quiet, the way they do before a big payout.
